title: Kissed Aromatic Kenyan Sweet Potato Grill
description: Sweet grilled sweet potatoes glazed with shio‑koji, brown sugar and ginger, served on a binchotan grill for a nostalgic Kenyan flavor.
instructions: Peel and slice the sweet potatoes into 1/2 inch thick rounds.
In a bowl whisk together shio‑koji paste, brown sugar, olive oil, smoked paprika, grated ginger, minced garlic, black pepper, lemon zest and sea salt until smooth.
Coat each sweet potato slice with the glaze, ensuring a thin even layer on both sides.
Preheat the binchotan grill to medium heat and lightly oil the grates.
Place the glazed slices on the grill and cook for 4 minutes per side, basting with more glaze halfway through.
Turn the slices until the edges are crisp and the interior is tender.
Remove from the grill and let them rest for 2 minutes.
Serve hot, optionally drizzled with extra glaze and a sprinkle of fresh herbs if desired.
